Interface JMSListenerRecoveryConfiguration

@ConfigurationProperties("micronaut.jms.listener-recovery") public interface JMSListenerRecoveryConfiguration
The configuration of how listeners recover when the JMS provider reports that the session of a consumer failed. When the connection of a listener reports an error, each of its consumers checks its session, and a consumer whose session no longer works closes its session and consumer and creates them again on the same connection. A failed attempt is retried, with a growing delay, until it succeeds or the listener shuts down.
Since:
5.2.0

  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      @Bindable(defaultValue="true") boolean isEnabled()
      Returns:
      Whether listeners recreate a session that the JMS provider reports as failed. Defaults to true.

    • getWarnAttempts

      @Min(1L) @Bindable(defaultValue="10") @Min(1L) int getWarnAttempts()
      Returns:
      The number of failed attempts to recreate a session that are logged as warnings. Later attempts are logged as errors, and continue until one succeeds or the listener shuts down. Defaults to 10.

    • getInitialDelay

      @Bindable(defaultValue="PT1S") Duration getInitialDelay()
      Returns:
      How long a consumer waits after a failed attempt before the next one. The wait doubles after each attempt, up to getMaxDelay(). It must be positive. Defaults to 1 second.

    • getMaxDelay

      @Bindable(defaultValue="PT1M") Duration getMaxDelay()
      Returns:
      The longest wait between two attempts, which every attempt waits once the doubling reaches it. It must not be shorter than getInitialDelay(). Defaults to 1 minute.
